requirements: R1: The backend application must successfully respond to HTTP health checks on the expected port without connection refusal.

slices.title: Remediate application health check connection refusal
slices.jtbd: When implementing the health check fix for this epic, I want to correct the port bindings and application configuration, so that the launched application successfully passes health checks on port 18080.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a deployed local environment,
When a HTTP GET request is made to the /health endpoint on port 18080,
Then the server must respond with a successful status code.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce container health check failure rate from 100% to 0%
